scripts.start: npm run docker:prod:up && npm run db:prod:init && npm run build:cypher && tsx src/app.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run build:cypher && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:functional
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:setup && npm run test:integration:run && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.test:functional: npm run test:setup && npm run test:functional:run && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.test:setup: npm run docker:test:up && npx wait-on tcp:localhost:7689 && npm run db:test:init
scripts.docker:prod:down: docker compose stop neo4j-prod && docker compose rm -f neo4j-prod
scripts.docker:test:down: docker compose stop neo4j-test && docker compose rm -f neo4j-test
scripts.db:prod:init: bash -c 'source .env.prod && docker compose --env-file .env.prod exec neo4j-prod cypher-shell -u "$NEO4J_USER" -p "$NEO4J_PASSWORD" -f /tmp/init.cypher'
scripts.db:prod:clean: bash -c 'source .env.prod && docker compose --env-file .env.prod exec neo4j-prod cypher-shell -u "$NEO4J_USER" -p "$NEO4J_PASSWORD" -d neo4j "MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n"'
scripts.db:prod:status: bash -c 'source .env.prod && docker compose --env-file .env.prod exec neo4j-prod cypher-shell -u "$NEO4J_USER" -p "$NEO4J_PASSWORD" "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) as total_nodes"'
scripts.db:test:init: bash -c 'source .env.test && docker run --rm --network host -v $(pwd)/database/init.cypher:/tmp/init.cypher neo4j:latest cypher-shell -u "$NEO4J_USER" -p "$NEO4J_PASSWORD" -a localhost:7689 -f /tmp/init.cypher'
scripts.db:test:clean: bash -c 'source .env.test && docker run --rm --network host neo4j:latest cypher-shell -u "$NEO4J_USER" -p "$NEO4J_PASSWORD" -a localhost:7689 -d neo4j "MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n"'
scripts.db:test:status: bash -c 'source .env.test && docker run --rm --network host neo4j:latest cypher-shell -u "$NEO4J_USER" -p "$NEO4J_PASSWORD" -a localhost:7689 "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) as total_nodes"'
